one_liner.zh: 加密与传统呈「同向 risk-off」：BTC 窗口 -6.2%，趋势高位震荡，杠杆价格动而 OI 变化有限（换手/挤压可能）；高实现波动且期权偏贵（IV 相对 RV 溢价）；现货 ETF 通道强流出（BTC 周净流 -12.45 亿美金）。
one_liner.en: Crypto and TradFi moved in risk-off sync: BTC window -6.2%, chop at elevated levels, leverage saw price move with limited OI change (churn/squeeze possible); high realized vol with options rich vs RV; spot ETF channel in strong outflow (BTC weekly net -1.25B).

zh: BTC ETF 周净流 -12.45 亿美金

risk.zh: 传统侧股指与黄金同步下挫、VIX 大幅抬升，加密侧 ETF 持续净流出叠加高实现波动，若 risk-off 延续，高位震荡区间下沿与杠杆换手是否升级为更明显出清仍待观察。
risk.en: TradFi equities and gold fell together while VIX spiked; crypto faced ongoing ETF outflows plus elevated realized vol—if risk-off persists, watch whether the chop range’s lower edge and two-sided churn escalate into clearer de-leveraging.

watch.zh: 盯住 ETF 流出是否缓和、IV-RV 溢价能否收窄，以及 OI 几乎不动的换手是否在下一轮波动中变成净去杠杆。
watch.en: Watch whether ETF outflows ease, the IV-RV premium narrows, and whether the near-flat OI churn flips into net de-leveraging on the next vol impulse.

leverage.zh: 价格动而 OI 变化有限（换手/挤压可能）

vol_premium.zh: 期权偏贵（IV 相对 RV 溢价）

compare.zh: 本周 BTC 窗口收益 -6.2%，ETH -6.0%，两者幅度接近；传统侧更猛：ES -8.5%、NQ -10.4%，黄金 -9.5%，VIX 大涨约 86%，美元指数仅小幅走强。加密并未独自走弱，而是与宽基 risk-off 同向，只是回撤略浅于美股科技与黄金。
compare.en: BTC window return -6.2% and ETH -6.0% moved in near lockstep; TradFi was sharper—ES -8.5%, NQ -10.4%, gold -9.5%, VIX up ~86%, DXY only mildly firmer. Crypto did not sell off in isolation but tracked broad risk-off, with a somewhat shallower drawdown than US tech and gold.

path.zh: 标签为高位震荡：价格自前周更深跌势中有所收敛，但仍录得约六个百分点的周跌，未形成单边趋势延续或清晰反转，更像在压力与支撑之间反复试探，波动本身成为主旋律。
path.en: Labeled chop at elevated levels: price cooled from the prior week’s steeper drop yet still finished down ~6%, without clean trend continuation or reversal—more a series of probes between pressure and support, with volatility itself as the main theme.

leverage.zh:
标签：价格动而 OI 变化有限（换手/挤压可能）。
① 拥挤线（OI + 资金费率年化）：周初约 -1.39%/yr → 期末约 +2.47%/yr，租金全周抬升；OI 周变约 -0.41%（93519 → 93140），全周库存仅略变——更像摩擦期，而非匀速大拆/大堆杠杆。
② 出清线（OI + 清算）：主峰日 11-20（2026-11-20）；峰值约 3.69× 周内中位清算量；价格同日约 -4.9%；当日 OI 约 96077；但 OI 周高在 2026-11-19（约 96998），峰值日并非双高；峰值日 OI 较前一日下降，偏出清/去库存与清算同日。次日 2026-11-21：OI 自峰值日回落至约 91787、funding 年化约 -3.01%/yr、价格约 +2.1%。
③ 量旁证（永续成交额=活跃度）：周合计约 1123.69 亿美金，环比约 +12.8%，活跃度中性；量侧用于核对热闹程度，不拆多空。
收句：①②③ 共同核对「价格动而 OI 变化有限（换手/挤压可能）」标签是否站得住；禁止把清算/OI/funding 写成涨跌原因。
leverage.en:
Label: two_sided_churn.
① Crowding (OI + funding ann.): ~-1.39%/yr → ~+2.47%/yr — rent rose over the week; OI week change ~-0.41% (93519 → 93140), inventory barely moved — friction week, not steady build/unwind.
② Flush (OI + liquidations): peak day 2026-11-20; peak ~3.69× median liq qty; price that day ~-4.9%; OI that day ~96077; OI week-high was 2026-11-19 (~96998), not a dual-high peak day; OI down vs prior day — flush/de-stocking with liquidations. Next day 2026-11-21: OI eased to ~91787; funding ~-3.01%/yr; price ~+2.1%.
③ Volume side (perp turnover = activity): week sum ~112.37B, WoW ~+12.8%, activity normal; activity only, not long/short.
Close: lines ①–③ check whether label “two_sided_churn” holds; do not write liq/OI/funding as the cause of price.

etf.zh: 美现货 BTC ETF 合计净申赎为 -12.45 亿美金（强流出：4 流出日 vs 1 流入日，单日最深约 -5.82 亿在 11-19）；ETH ETF 净 -2.22 亿、五日全流出。并陈 Binance 等口径现货成交额周合计约 120.14 亿美金、环比 +11.5%，现货通道热闹度与 ETF 净流出同周出现，总量反映参与热度，不与净流加总、不拆多空。
etf.en: US spot BTC ETFs saw combined net -1.25B (strong outflow: 4 outflow days vs 1 inflow; deepest day ~-582M on 11-19); ETH ETFs net -221.7M with five outflow days. Alongside, spot exchange turnover summed ~12.01B (+11.5% WoW). Spot activity heat and ETF net outflow coexisted this week; turnover is participation breadth only—do not sum with net flow or split long/short.

spot_volume.zh: Binance 现货成交额（turnover 美金，程序周合计）：本周 120.14 亿美金，相对上完整周 +11.5%（活跃度「中性」；上周约 107.75 亿美金）。峰值日 2026-11-21（28.21 亿美金）。这是交易所现货「换手热闹程度」，与 ETF 净申赎同属现货世界、只并陈；对照永续周成交额 1123.69 亿美金——两者量级不同，**禁止相加**，也**不能**拆多空。
spot_volume.en: Binance spot turnover (USD, program week sum): this week 12.01B, vs prior full week +11.5% (activity “normal”; prior ~10.77B). Peak day 2026-11-21 (2.82B). Spot tape busyness beside ETF net flow — same spot world, no sum with perp (112.37B); not a long/short split.

vol_teach.zh: 高 RV 意味着路径已经很「贵」；若 IV 仍高于 RV，说明期权市场在为未来波动支付额外保费。本周属于「已经动得够剧烈，保险却仍不便宜」的组合，而非波动枯竭后的静默贵。
vol_teach.en: High RV means the path already priced in a lot of movement; IV still above RV means the options market is paying an extra premium for future vol. This week was “already violent, yet insurance still not cheap,” not rich vol after a quiet spell.

vol_week.zh: BTC 实现波动年化约 48.7%，处高实现波动区间；期末 IV 约 55.4%（Deribit），IV-RV 价差约 +6.7 个百分点，期权相对 RV 偏贵。ETH 侧 RV 约 72.3%、IV 约 69.8%，实现端更高、溢价结构与 BTC 不完全同构。
vol_week.en: BTC realized vol ~48.7% ann., in the high-RV regime; end IV ~55.4% (Deribit) left IV-RV spread ~+6.7 pp—options rich vs RV. ETH showed RV ~72.3% vs IV ~69.8%, realized running hotter and the premium structure not identical to BTC.

vol_combo.zh: 高实现波动 + IV 相对 RV 溢价，叠加价格高位震荡与杠杆换手：方向标签并不单边，但波动与期权定价都偏「紧」，任何突破震荡边界的动作都可能被放大定价。
vol_combo.en: High RV + IV rich vs RV, plus elevated chop and leverage churn: direction is not one-sided, yet both realized path and option pricing sit tight—any break of the chop range can be amplified in pricing.

vol_price_iv.zh: 价格周跌约 6% 的同时 IV 收在 55.4%、仍高于 RV，显示下跌过程并未把隐含波动「砸成便宜」；溢价残留，和「只跌价格、波动溢价未充分释放」的读法一致。
vol_price_iv.en: Price fell ~6% while IV ended 55.4% and still above RV—the decline did not crush implied vol into cheap territory. Residual premium fits a reading of price down without full release of the vol premium.

vol_vix.zh: VIX 窗口大涨约 86%，与加密高 RV、同向 risk-off 标签相互印证：传统恐慌指标与加密实现波动同周抬升，而非加密独有的波动事件。
vol_vix.en: VIX window return ~+86% rhymes with crypto’s high RV and the risk-off-sync label: traditional fear gauge and crypto realized vol rose together, not a crypto-only vol episode.

what.zh: 美股隐含波动指数 VIX

vs_crypto.zh: VIX 中低位小动通常解释不了币的大涨跌；与上一节加密 IV 只做角色对照。
vs_crypto.en: Small VIX moves rarely explain big crypto moves; role-parallel to crypto IV only.

vs_crypto.zh: 美元走强时对风险资产偏逆风。
vs_crypto.en: Stronger USD is often a headwind for risk assets.

vs_crypto.zh: 利率与币涨跌若相反，则不是单纯降息交易。
vs_crypto.en: If yields move opposite crypto, this is not a pure cut-trade story.

vs_crypto.zh: 与 BTC 同向可兼容，但是不同资产逻辑。
vs_crypto.en: Same direction as BTC is compatible; drivers still differ.

tradfi_summary.zh: 美股括号内 ES -8.5%、NQ -10.4%，黄金 -9.5%，美债 10Y 收益率下行约 24 bp，DXY +0.4%，VIX 大涨。风险资产与黄金同跌、波动飙升，呈现典型 risk-off；加密跌幅略浅但仍落在同一叙事框内。
tradfi_summary.en: In the US session bracket ES -8.5%, NQ -10.4%, gold -9.5%, US10Y yield -24.2 bp, DXY +0.4%, VIX sharply higher. Risk assets and gold fell together with vol spiking—classic risk-off; crypto’s milder drop still sat inside the same frame.

three_conclusions.zh: 本周是传统与加密的同向 risk-off：股指、黄金大跌，VIX 飙升，BTC/ETH 跟跌但幅度略浅，现货 ETF 强流出与高 RV 同框，而非加密单独的基本面故事。
three_conclusions.en: The week was shared risk-off: equities and gold sold off hard, VIX spiked, BTC/ETH followed with a milder drawdown; strong spot-ETF outflow and high RV sat in the same frame, not a crypto-only fundamental tale.

three_conclusions.zh: 杠杆画像是「价动仓不动」：OI 周变仅约 -0.4%，funding 温和正，清算峰值在 11-20，永续量能环比升，更偏换手/局部挤压，而非杠杆泡沫单边爆破。
three_conclusions.en: Leverage read as price-moving-while-OI-stayed-put: OI ~-0.4% on the week, funding mildly positive, liquidation peak on 11-20, perp turnover up WoW—more churn/local squeeze than one-way leverage blow-off.

three_conclusions.zh: 波动与期权：RV 已高，IV 仍相对 RV 溢价约 6.7 pp，下跌并未送出「便宜保险」；叠加 ETF 强流出，现货通道与定价偏贵同时存在，是本周最需并陈的矛盾。
three_conclusions.en: Vol/options: RV already high, IV still ~6.7 pp rich vs RV—the decline did not deliver cheap insurance; paired with strong ETF outflow, busy spot channel and rich pricing coexisted—the week’s core tension to hold side-by-side.

text.zh: BTC 现货 ETF 净流是否从「强流出」转为单日净流入增多或周净流出明显收窄（对照本周 -12.45 亿与 4 出 1 进）。
text.en: Whether BTC spot ETF net flow shifts from strong outflow toward more inflow days or a clearly smaller weekly net drain (vs this week’s -1.25B and 4 out / 1 in).

watch_items.rationale_zh: 本周强流出与 risk-off 同框，若流出持续性减弱，是检验现货通道压力是否缓和的直接哨点。

text.zh: IV-RV 价差是否仍维持溢价（本周末约 +6.7 pp），或在高 RV 之后出现 IV 回落、溢价收窄甚至转折价。
text.en: Whether the IV-RV spread stays rich (about +6.7 pp at week-end) or IV cools after high RV so the premium narrows or flips to discount.

watch_items.rationale_zh: 下跌后保险仍偏贵是本周特征；溢价能否消化直接关系到下一阶段波动定价是否仍紧。

text.zh: OI 在下一轮明显价格波动中是否仍接近零变化，或转为显著上升/下降，以确认换手标签是否升级为净加/减杠杆。
text.en: Whether OI remains near-unchanged on the next clear price swing or shifts to a material rise/fall, testing if churn upgrades into net leverage add/remove.

watch_items.rationale_zh: 本周价动 OI 不动是核心杠杆矛盾；后续 OI 路径可验证是持续换手还是酝酿出清/重建。

matched.zh: 高位震荡 + 高实现波动 + 杠杆以换手为主而非单边加仓，价格在区间内来回摩擦的特征，与均值回归类逻辑更合拍：趋势延续信号弱，波动提供回归交易的路径厚度。
matched.en: Elevated chop, high realized vol, and leverage dominated by churn rather than one-way OI build favor mean-reversion-style logic: weak trend-continuation signal, with vol supplying path thickness for range reversion.

mismatched.zh: 趋势跟随本周不对齐：标签为高位震荡而非趋势加速，周收益为负但较前周收窄，OI 几乎不动，缺乏「方向 + 仓位扩张」的经典趋势确认。
mismatched.en: Trend-following mismatched: label is chop at highs rather than trend acceleration; weekly return negative but less severe than prior week, OI nearly flat—missing classic confirmation of direction plus position expansion.

disclaimer.en: Strategy backdrop = condition fit, not investment advice; no products, no position sizes.

why.en: Trend label “chop_high” lacks a clear one-way trend condition.

note.zh: 旁注：实现波动高或清算偏尖——即便趋势环境在，路径也可能很颠/拥挤。
note.en: Note: high realized vol or liquidation spike — trend backdrop can still be a rough path.

why.zh: 趋势偏震荡/磨盘（高位震荡），更接近区间来回而非单边趋势条件。 但高波宽幅震荡时，回归类也会很颠。
why.en: Trend reads choppy/grind (chop_high); closer to range-bound than one-way trend. Wide high-vol chop is still rough for reversion-style paths.

why.zh: IV 虽相对偏贵，但实现波动已高——收保费叙事与路径冲击叙事打架，保持中性。
why.en: IV is rich vs RV but realized vol is already high — premium vs path-shock narratives conflict; neutral.

summary.zh: 相对上周：BTC 收益由约 -12.7% 收窄至 -6.2%；关注标签 S2→S1；趋势/IV 溢价/传统联动等标签仍活跃但叙事从更深跌切到高位震荡与同向 risk-off；BTC ETF 净流由约 -10.65 亿变为 -12.45 亿美金，流出力度未减。
summary.en: Vs prior week: BTC return improved from ~-12.7% to -6.2%; attention S2→S1; trend / IV-premium / TradFi-link labels stayed relevant but shifted from deeper slide to elevated chop and risk-off sync; BTC ETF net moved from ~-1.07B to -1.25B, outflow intensity undiminished.
